$CRWV is down more than 16% today and has crashed more than 50% in the last 5 months.

Bonds trading this low are treated as distressed.

That is a big problem, because it plans to spend $35B to $39B this year and has only $5.5B in cash. It has to keep borrowing to keep building.

Credit default swaps, which investors use to insure against default, now price a 58% chance that CoreWeave defaults within 5 years.
